research_notes: Follow up bounded full-time legal practice intervals, breaks, early solicitor/paralegal dates and employers; verify Kemp Strang lead and chambers transitions. Resolve paid sporting contracts and control rather than treating scholarship as public work.

2026-09-29 avenues: current self biography, two surviving chambers PDFs, contemporaneous Lawyers Weekly interview, FIS, ABR history, OWIA 2006/2014 reports, ASADA 2018–19 and AIS archive. APH direct access blocked; frozen official extraction retained. Public professional-profile searches did not produce a directly verifiable CV for earlier firms.

Unverified search-index leads from SignalHire (not accepted as employment evidence): Roper & Steggall 2004–2007, Kemp Strang October 2007–April 2008, Sixth Floor May 2008–September 2014, Garfield Barwick September 2014–January 2016, Family Law Chambers January 2016–May 2019; Ski and Snowboard Association board 2002–2006. Verify with firm/bar archives or legitimately public first-party profile. No contact data retained.

Conflicts retained: athlete 1989 versus 1990 start, initial OWIA term ending 2002 versus 2006, Queenwood 2017 versus 2018 and bar committee 2013 versus 2014. Full-time point observation in 2009 cannot support 11 years. Multiple board and arbitration roles overlap legal practice; no summation. Last follow-up 2026-09-29, unresolved initial record.

2026-10-01 follow-up: full OWIA2006/2014/2019 reports resolve first resignation14June2006 and later term22November2013–27May2019, preserving contrary CV values in notes. Primary2014 Bar seating list verifies Sixth Floor affiliation; exact chambers transition dates still unverified.2025 childcare speech adds working-pattern evidence, without inferring part-time or leave duration.2020 parental-leave speech supplies policy discussion only, not personal leave dates.

Remaining avenues: firm/Bar archives for Roper & Steggall and Kemp Strang employment and legal-practice hours; original OWIA1998/1999 appointment; Queenwood and Hall of Fame appointment/cessation records. It is not treated as payroll employment, proof of uninterrupted work or full-time hours. Searches for Kemp Strang, Roper & Steggall and NSW Bar archives otherwise returned existing firm-name corroboration, unrelated Kemp Strang partners and point-in-time law-almanac/chambers material; no independently supported Kemp Strang spell or earlier transition dates were found. Sporting contracts, legal-practice hours, leave and exact Roper/solicitor boundaries remain unresolved.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: a contemporary NSW Bar Association notice records acceptance as a member on21May2008 and lists Sixth Floor Selborne/Wentworth chambers, materially adding an exact early professional point inside the existing2008–2019 self-employed envelope. A Bar News readers list corroborates the2008 cohort but does not add a paid-work boundary. Renewed Kemp Strang and Roper & Steggall searches still found only the unverified aggregator timeline or derivative biographies; no firm appointment, hours, leave or continuous-practice proof was found.
